rules.summary: All states were directed to operationalise the grievance and money restoration modules and to dispose of account-freeze cases quickly. The grievance route does not bar other legal remedies.
Police seizure power. High Courts disagree on whether it allows freezing a bank account; the Supreme Court has not settled the question.
Attachment of property goes through a magistrate, with notice and a hearing.
